description:
Symptom: error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan] "boxed closure call in FunctionId(N) expects delivered lane(s) [] / [RawAtom] but construction wrapper ... publishes [ValueRef]" (a panic at jobs/backend.rs:180 on some paths). This is fz-sc8.119 item 1 (scratchpad handoff/m2.fz) and the error fz-sc8.131's repro stops at first.

Cause (verified by probe on 3038a76af): BoxedApplyRequirement::for_body (src/compiler2/backend_program/boxed_contract.rs) gives a Seam closure call whose return flow is NoReturn the owning body's own return lanes. A NoReturn call has an empty result type and reads nothing back from the seam (native lowers it to TailCallClosure), so the requirement is invented: [] when the body diverges, [RawAtom] when the body returns an atom such as :first. BoxedContracts::validate reconciles requirements per arity across the whole program, so that invented requirement is compared with an unrelated wrapper's [ValueRef].

Fix: a NoReturn seam call contributes no requirement. Tail and a missing flow keep the body's return lanes.

Spike (scratchpad s131/spike.patch, 4 lines): m2.fz and OptionParser's n1b.fz compile and match elixir on interp, run and build; lib 2169 passed, no pin moved.

Acceptance: a boxed_contract test stating the intent; fixtures from m2.fz and n1b.fz with elixir oracles on three paths; full gate; distill gate after landing.

Does not fix fz-sc8.131's own repro: past this check it hits a second fault (a continuation entry laid out for a zero-lane callable receives a boxed closure), which stays on fz-sc8.131.
title: A closure call that never returns asks nothing of the boxed return convention
